description: Turn goals into execution-ready plans. Handles both underspecified requests and fuzzy problem statements by investigating enough to compare options, choose a path, and write ordered steps. Unlike b-implement, b-plan does not change code. Routing signals: plan, decompose, approach, explore, not sure, figure out, "how should I", implementation plan, clarify, requirements, scope. Delegated: runs only in the `b-planner` subagent; the main session never executes it itself.
